svg.title: Gaia Discovery AI system architecture
svg.desc: Rubin alerts through Fink enter IRIS. Native BPL validates AI decisions, routes catalog queries through Java PEX, saves reports and conditionally requests native human review. OpenAI provides chat and eligible report embeddings.
svg.text: From astronomical alerts to evidence-backed preliminary investigations
IRIS AI Hub EAP 154 · USER namespace
One native runtime: interoperability, Python, persistence and human workflow
No agent tools or image analysis
Runtime packaging: Docker Compose / IPM • TAP transport: Java PEX via %Java Server
Solid arrows: application calls and data flow
Dashed arrows: conditional review or optional embedding path
Architecture illustration, not execution evidence. Positional proximity, semantic similarity and ACCEPT do not confirm a discovery.
